text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O still hasn't arrived for our training session. Just when I start to think she might not come at all…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I laid down earlier, intending to rest a little until it was time for training, but then I fell asleep…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You see, last night, I watched a scary video, and then it kept popping into my head every time I tried to shut my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To distract myself, I decided to make some desserts. But I got too into it, and the next thing I knew, it was morning… That's actually the scariest part…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry my carelessness caused so much trouble! I'll be more careful from now on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O seems genuinely remorseful for her actions, so I let her off with a light warning.
